regular.label: Regular resting breathing at 15 breaths per minute

watch.label: Regular but fast: 22 breaths per minute

tachypnea.label: Rapid and irregular breathing at about 28 per minute

unsteady.label: Very irregular intervals around 22 per minute

apnea.label: Regular breathing with a twelve-second pause

motion.label: Regular breathing with a four-second movement

absent.label: Nobody breathing in the zone: noise only
